propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, in te sperantium fortitudo, adesto propitius invocationibus nostris:
et, quia sine te nihil potest mortalis infirmitas, praesta auxilium gratiae
tuae; ut, in exsequendis mandatis tuis, et voluntate tibi et actione
placeamus. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, the strength of them that hope in Thee, graciously be present with us when we invoke Thee, and, because mortal infirmity can do nothing without Thee, grant us the assistance of Thy grace that, in executing Thy commands, we may be pleasing to Thee both in our desires and in our deeds. Through our Lord.
